Ava: Hey all — first day! Trying to link our onboarding project `redwood-onboard-ava` to the company billing account but `gcloud beta billing projects link` fails with `PERMISSION_DENIED: The caller does not have permission`.
Carlos: welcome Ava :wave: you need two things: a Billing Account User role on the billing account (granted by finance) and a Project Billing Manager (or project owner) on the target project. If finance gives the Billing Account User role you can run the link command.
Ava: thanks — can you paste the exact roles/command? I don’t want to poke the wrong thing in prod.
Carlos: sure. billing account role name is `roles/billing.user` on the billing account resource. project role is `roles/billing.projectManager` on the project. Example command:
```
gcloud beta billing projects link redwood-onboard-ava --billing-account=01A2B3-4C5D6E
```
Also make sure your gcloud is authenticated as the account that has the project role.
Maria: @Ava I can grant the Billing Account User on the billing account but need the project ID and which group should be added. Do you want to add your user or the `eng-onboarding@redwood.com` group?
Ava: please add `eng-onboarding@redwood.com` if possible — that covers future hires too.
Maria: noted, I'll request it. FYI finance requires a short justification for the billing link (project name + owner) — can you paste that here?
Ava: sure: "Onboarding sandbox for new hires to test infra + deploy samples — owner: Ava (eng)."
Sam: one extra hiccup we've seen: org policies sometimes block certain regions or prevent creation of certain resource types. If you're getting a separate 403 while creating a service account in `asia-northeast1` check org policy for `compute/regionRestrictions`.
Ava: I did see a 403 when creating a SA in `asia-northeast1`, but us-central1 worked. How do I check the org policy?
Sam: infra folks can check via console -> Organization policies or run:
```
gcloud org-policies describe constraints/compute.restrictRegionalResources --organization=123456789012
```
If it's blocked you can either request an exception or use an allowed region.
infra-bot: Deploy bot note: project `redwood-onboard-ava` currently has no billing linked. Blocking automated sandbox provisioning.
Carlos: @Maria once billing-user is granted on the billing account I can add the `eng-onboarding` group as Project Billing Manager and run the link. Maria: please send me the billing account id if you want me to do it.
Maria: sending via DM now :locked_with_key:
Ava: thanks everyone — will wait for the grant and then try the command. Appreciate the quick help! :pray:
Carlos: if you hit any more errors paste the exact `gcloud` output and we’ll triage. welcome aboard again! :tada:
Ava: update — finance granted Billing Account User and I ran the link command successfully. onboarding project is linked. Thanks all :rocket:
